cards.card_text: His kinsman Asaph, from Gershom's clan, served at his right hand, and on the left were their kinsmen the sons of Merari, starting with Ethan.
cards.verse_text: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea, the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah, the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei, the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
cards.snippet: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of…

cards.card_text: Then he tells his son to say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and to call understanding his kinsman.
